results.title: Muse Realtime Avatar Is Now in the Muse App: What Shipped
results.description: The rollout is a distribution fact, not a capability fact, and the two get blurred constantly in the week after something ships. Meta's own account is a single post from the @AIatMeta account, timestamped 18:36 UTC on 5 November, and it is unusually terse for a product release. It says the company previewed Muse Realtime Avatar during Connect, describes it again as "our real-time embodiment technology that turns Muse Realtime Voice into expressive, interactive avatars," and then states that it is rolling out in the Muse app in the US to give people "a more natural way to engage with their personal agents."
